listings.title: Grandma Garden Sweatshirt Custom Wildflower Crewneck Sweater, Custom Wildflower Sweater, Personalized Grandma Gift, Mothers Day Crewneck
listings.description:
🌸 WELCOME TO GRANDMA'S GARDEN — WHERE LOVE BLOOMS!

Celebrate the most cherished woman in your family with our handcrafted Grandma's Garden crewneck sweatshirt or garment-dyed tee. Each wildflower represents a grandchild's birth month, creating a deeply sentimental keepsake she will wear with pride.

✨ WHY SHE WILL CHERISH THIS:
• Ultra-soft Comfort Colors 1717 / Gildan 18000 heavy blend fleece (50% cotton / 50% polyester).
• Premium direct-to-garment (DTG) print with eco-friendly water-based inks that won't crack or peel.
• The ultimate gift for Mother's Day, Grandma's Birthday, Christmas, or pregnancy reveals!

🌿 PERSONALIZATION OPTIONS:
Names included: Emma, Liam, Olivia, Noah
Simply enter each child's name and birth month in the personalization box, and our studio will hand-arrange each coordinating flower into her custom bouquet.

📏 SIZING CHART (Unisex Relaxed Fit - True to Size):
• S:  Width 20" | Length 27"
• M:  Width 22" | Length 28"
• L:  Width 24" | Length 29"
• XL: Width 26" | Length 30"
• 2XL: Width 28" | Length 31"
• 3XL: Width 30" | Length 32"
💡 Tip: For that trendy oversized cozy aesthetic, size up 1 to 2 sizes!

🧺 CARE & WASHING INSTRUCTIONS:
• Machine wash cold, inside out, with like colors.
• Use mild detergent; avoid bleach and fabric softeners.
• Tumble dry on low or hang dry for longest graphic vibrancy.
• Do not iron directly on the print.

🚚 FAST US PRODUCTION & SHIPPING:
• Handcrafted and printed in the USA in 2–4 business days.
• Standard tracked shipping: 3–5 business days to your doorstep.

💖 100% HAPPINESS GUARANTEE: If she doesn't absolutely tear up with joy, message us for a free replacement!

listings.title: Vintage French Lavender Canvas Tote Bag Botanical Market Bag, Farmers Market Bag, Botanical Library Tote, Heavyweight Garden Shopper
listings.description:
🌻 YOUR TIMELESS COMPANION FOR THE FARMERS MARKET & LIBRARY

Step out in effortless French country style with our 12oz heavyweight cotton canvas tote bag. Featuring authentic 19th-century botanical seed catalog artwork with heirloom wildflowers and French lavender, this bag seamlessly balances vintage charm with everyday durability.

✨ WHY YOU'LL REACH FOR THIS DAILY:
• Heavy 12oz 100% natural cotton canvas holds heavy produce, books, and yarn without sagging.
• Reinforced stitching on all stress points and durable 22" shoulder straps.
• Wide bottom gusset allows tote to stand upright while loading fresh sourdough, flowers, or library novels.

👜 DIMENSIONS:
• Bag Size: 15" Width x 16" Height with 3" Bottom Gusset
• Handle Length: 22" reinforced fabric straps (11" drop for comfortable shoulder carry)

🧼 CARE INSTRUCTIONS:
• Spot clean with cold water and mild soap.
• Air dry flat to preserve crisp shape and fabric sizing.

🌾 SUSTAINABLE & REUSABLE: Replace plastic bags with a durable, heirloom-quality tote you will enjoy for years.

listings.title: Barn Star Quilt Pattern Blueprint Printable Template Vector Kit, Printable Patchwork Blueprint, Lone Star Cutting Guide
listings.description:
🧵 MASTER THE TIMELESS TRADITIONAL BARN STAR QUILT

Create an heirloom quilt that will be cherished across generations with our step-by-step Barn Star Blueprint. Engineered with clear vector diagrams, precision rotary cutting charts, and visual pressing arrows, this pattern takes all the frustration out of matching 8-point diamond seams.

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE THE BLUEPRINT:
• Complete fabric yardage requirements for Baby, Throw, and Queen sizes.
• Color-coded strip piecing charts that save hours of hand cutting.
• Full-size printable paper templates (100% scale - no enlargement needed).
• Master Pressing Roadmap to ensure your center points nest flat without bulk.

📐 PATTERN SPECIFICATIONS:
• Finished Quilt Size: 64" x 64" Throw / Wall Hanging
• Block Size: 24" x 24" Center Star Medallion
• Skill Level: Confident Beginner to Intermediate

📄 FORMAT: 12-Page Illustrated PDF Guide with 1/4" Seam Allowance Diagrams, Fabric Yardage Chart, and Rotary Cutting Cheat Sheets.

✂️ INSTANT PDF ACCESS: Download immediately after purchase and start sewing tonight!
